# UniLexical

> Framework-agnostic, Notion-style block rich-text editor powered by Meta's Lexical engine. Features pure TypeScript core, thin Vue 3, React, and Vanilla JS wrappers, hover action handles, drag-and-drop block reordering, slash commands, real-time markdown shortcuts, GFM tables, and clean HTML/Markdown serialization.

UniLexical decouples editor state, document schemas, and command handling from framework view layers. The core is 100% pure TypeScript, while Vue 3 and React bindings are thin lifecycle and reactivity adapters, guaranteeing identical editing behavior across stacks.

## Documentation

- [Documentation Index](docs/index.md): Master landing page organized following the Diátaxis technical documentation framework.
- [Project Readme](README.md): Primary repository documentation, quickstart guides, and feature highlights.

## Tutorials

- [Getting Started Tutorial](docs/tutorials/getting-started.md): Step-by-step beginner guide to installing UniLexical and mounting an editor with live preview in Vanilla JS, Vue 3, or React.

## How-to Guides

- [Image and File Uploads](docs/how-to/image-and-file-upload.md): Configure custom S3, OSS, or REST API image/attachment uploaders, file size limits, paste screenshots, and drag-and-drop media.
- [Toolbar and Slash Customization](docs/how-to/toolbar-and-shortcuts.md): Configure toolbar item subsets, register custom action buttons, customize the Notion-style `/` slash menu, and use markdown shortcuts.
- [Tables, Callouts and Serialization](docs/how-to/markdown-and-tables.md): Work with GFM markdown tables, callout blocks (`:::info`), toggle blocks (`<details>`), and import/export clean Markdown and HTML.
- [Headless Mode and Custom UI](docs/how-to/headless-and-custom-ui.md): Run the editor in headless mode (`builtinUI: false`) and build custom toolbars using Vue 3 and React `useLexical` hooks.
